title: Top bar
caption: GNOME 51's black top bar: Activities with the workspace dots, the centred clock, and the status icons that open quick settings.

title: Date menu
caption: The clock opens the notification list beside the calendar, with today's events from the calendar server underneath.

title: Tray menus
caption: An AppIndicator (StatusNotifierItem) gets a panel icon, and its menu opens from the panel.

title: Quick settings
caption: Volume and brightness sliders over the toggle grid. Each toggle reads its daemon: NetworkManager, BlueZ, power-profiles-daemon and GSettings.

title: Wi-Fi menu
caption: Networks grouped and sorted as GNOME does, scanned while the menu stays open; picking a saved one activates it.

title: Wi-Fi password
caption: A secured network NetworkManager has no secret for: the shell's secret agent asks with GNOME's dialog.

title: Wired connections
caption: The Wired toggle's menu: Disconnect for the active profile, and Wired Settings.

title: Bluetooth menu
caption: Paired devices with Connect or Disconnect, and Bluetooth Settings.

title: Microphone
caption: While an app records, an orange microphone leads the panel and a Microphone slider sits under the volume slider.

title: Power menu
caption: Suspend, Restart…, Power Off… and Log Out…, open in place.

title: Volume OSD
caption: gnome-settings-daemon's volume keys show GNOME's on-screen display through ShowOSD.

title: Brightness OSD
caption: The brightness key steps the backlight through logind and shows the level.

title: Windows
caption: libadwaita windows placed by Mutter's cascade; the focused one on top.

title: App popovers
caption: A header-bar menu opens as an xdg popup at the place its positioner asks for.

title: Edge tiling
caption: Dragging a window to the left edge shows the tile preview over the left half.

title: Window menu
caption: Right-clicking a header bar opens GNOME's window menu.

title: X11 apps
caption: XWayland starts with the session, and X11 apps get GNOME placement and focus.

title: Alt+Tab
caption: One icon per app in most-recently-used order; releasing Alt focuses the highlighted one.

title: Window thumbnails
caption: An app with several windows shows them as thumbnails (Down, or Alt+Above_Tab).

title: Overview
caption: Super opens the overview: live previews with app icons, the search entry and the dash.

title: Workspaces
caption: With windows on more than one workspace, the thumbnail strip shows above the previews.

title: Moving windows
caption: Dragging a preview onto the next workspace moves the window there.

title: Workspace switcher
caption: A workspace key outside the overview shows GNOME's workspace popup.

title: Search
caption: Typing in the overview searches apps; the top hit is Enter's target.

title: Search providers
caption: GNOME Shell search providers over D-Bus add their own results.

title: App grid
caption: Show Apps opens the grid, with GNOME's app folders as tiles.

title: App folders
caption: A folder opens GNOME's folder dialog with its apps.

title: Pages
caption: More apps than fit page the grid, with indicators and arrows.

title: Making folders
caption: Dropping one app on another makes a folder of the two.

title: Reordering
caption: An app dropped on a tile's edge moves there, and the order is saved to app-picker-layout.

title: Banners
caption: A notification sent over org.freedesktop.Notifications shows a banner at the top.

title: Notification list
caption: The banner then waits in the date menu's list.

title: Do Not Disturb
caption: Do Not Disturb holds banners back but keeps them in the list.

title: Screenshot UI
caption: Print opens GNOME's screenshot UI: area, screen or window.

title: Authentication
caption: polkit's requests show GNOME's authentication dialog.

title: End session
caption: Power Off… opens GNOME's 60-second confirmation dialog.

title: Lock screen
caption: Suspending locks the session; the curtain shows the clock.

title: Unlock
caption: A key raises the unlock prompt; the password is checked through PAM.

title: Display scale
caption: A 125% scale set through Mutter's DisplayConfig applies live.
